_notes: Owner must supply the capability statement PDF, equipment list and references. Procurement page. All credential facts are bracket tokens until the owner confirms them. 'capabilityStatement' is a download link the engineering agent wires to a PDF the owner supplies.

seo.title: Commercial & Strata Landscaping in Greater Victoria
seo.description: Grounds maintenance and landscape work for stratas, property managers, institutions and contractors in Greater Victoria. Request a free quote and site visit.

lede: Grounds maintenance, installation, irrigation and tree work for stratas, property managers, public and institutional buyers, and general contractors across Greater Victoria.

items.title: Strata councils
items.body: A written scope and visit calendar council can approve, and one contact for owner concerns.

items.title: Property managers
items.body: Several sites on one schedule, with issue reports in writing.

items.title: Public and institutional buyers
items.body: Municipalities, school districts, health and campus facilities, housing providers, churches and nonprofits. We can respond to formal requests and work to your specification.

items.title: General contractors and developers
items.body: Soft and hard landscape packages built to drawings, coordinated through your site supervisor.

sections.heading: Documents and compliance
body: Copies are available on request with any formal submission.

items.title: Equipment
items.body: An equipment list is available on request.

sections.heading: Safety on site
body: We plan work around occupants, traffic and public access, use signage and barriers where needed, and follow the site's safety rules and orientation. Safety program details: [WORKSAFEBC STATUS].

sections.heading: How we respond to a request

items.title: Send the request
items.body: Use the [quote form](/free-quote/) or email [EMAIL] with your specification or drawings.

items.title: Site review
items.body: We visit the site and note questions about the scope.

items.title: Written submission
items.body: A written quote to your scope, with documents you request.

items.title: Start-up meeting
items.body: Agree contacts, schedule, reporting and site rules before work starts.

sections.heading: Request a quote or site visit
body: [Get a free quote](/free-quote/) or [download the capability statement](/downloads/rnc-capability-statement.pdf).
